Topology/Color constructor makes original ColorAlpha(color,255) but displayed keeps input Color (possibly different alpha). Blank singleton private ctor allnull. setDisplayedColor changes only displayed; resetColor restores construction-time original reference, not latest category color. Sorting model rebuilds icons so original baseline becomes current category color. paintIcon saves Graphics color, dispatches event/state/arrow else blank, restores color ordinary return not finally; no transform/clip/stroke/composite snapshot. All branches fill background using current Parameters.BACKGROUND_COLOR alias. State red horizontal centerline behind displayed fill29x17 offset3,2 then current STATE_BORDER.paintStateBorder Graphics2D cast, both edges true. Arrow displayed horizontal shaft x..x+34 at y+10, triangle outline tip right, base8left and +/-5. Event red centerline, displayed ellipse29x5 offset3,2, white outline and white stem x+17 y+7..y+18. Blank background only; no null Parameters/Graphics guard. Icon paint reads preferences dynamically but does not initialize TopControl/Parameters or mutate Category. Does not execute archived GUI.
